visualGeneration.scenePrompt: Create the final production scene image derived from the LEFT desktop cinematic cafe scene in the reference, not a UI mockup. ONE single seamless wide 3:2 or 16:9 photograph, high resolution 2048 pixels wide or higher. REMOVE ALL text, logos, UI, borders, desktop/mobile labels, input fields, subtitles; no inset mobile screen. Make Mira more strikingly beautiful, with gracefully balanced features, expressive almond-shaped deep brown eyes and soft catchlights, refined straight nose, naturally defined lips, flattering luminous healthy skin with real fine texture, softly arched brows. Still a believable original adult 26-year-old woman, not a celebrity, not a doll, natural makeup. Neat voluminous dark brown layered shoulder-length hair, gently swept fringe framing her face, silver star hairpin clearly visible. A subtle warm closed-mouth smile, intimate attentive eye contact, her head mostly upright (not leaning on hand), both natural hands relaxed around a ceramic coffee cup. Amber raincoat and cream blouse unchanged in concept. Compose character center at x=68%, head center at x=68%, y=29%; top of head at y=9%, face lower edge at y=43%; body down to x=45%..94%, y=90%. Seated across walnut cafe table. Left 43% of image is a BIG dark blue rain window, perfectly straight vertical window panes, with soft city bokeh behind it, FEWER tiny static droplets because we will animate drops in code, enough clean glass area for animation, lower window sill at y=70%. Indoor warm amber lamps behind the woman on right, beautifully balanced soft portrait lighting on face, clear facial details, good dynamic range. Table visible at bottom 23%, modest coffee and a vintage unbranded camera, no conspicuous logos, no other people. Strong depth of field, photo realism, believable clothing/fingers/anatomy. Cozy contemporary cafe editorial portrait, emotionally warm, sophisticated photographic composition. The window occupies LEFT side only; never overlay water on woman's skin. This asset will fill an immersive app and be cropped responsively; keep her face between x=58-77%, y=18-44%. No UI or writing anywhere.

visualGeneration.photoPrompt: A single photorealistic travel photograph, landscape 4:3. Quiet northern coast with a small white lighthouse topped in dark slate red and a tiny weathered keeper cottage, winding dirt path through windswept dune grass leading towards it, ocean to left, late summer golden hour, soft sea haze and subtle film grain. Intimate nostalgic photography shot by a young adult travel photographer. Beautiful natural muted amber, sage, dusty blue tones. Not a painting, no people, no text, no logos, no border, no Polaroid frame, no UI. This will be the actual photograph inside a small keepsake print in a cinematic narrative app.
visualGeneration.runtimeEffects: Canvas rain condensation, droplet collection, gravity, fading trails and refraction; CSS character breathing, blinking, expression crossfades and camera movement. Not generated video or phoneme-level lip synchronization.

ambience.source: Original procedural electric-piano composition; door chime adapted from the user-selected CC0 Japanese Furin recording by ayustat2001
ambience.regeneration: Node.js and FFmpeg; CC0 source excerpt is bundled under server/fixtures/ambience; runtime uses the encoded MP3 assets

doorBell.style: Three light Japanese Furin strikes, softer irregular rebounds and a short natural tail; original pitch retained
doorBell.title: Furin japanese wind chime.wav
doorBell.author: ayustat2001
doorBell.sourceFormat: Public HQ MP3 preview of the original recording
doorBell.modifications: Retained the 4.272-second source; isolated its 0.35-1.65 second strike, arranged at 0.03/0.43/0.93 seconds with gains 1/0.67/0.44; 150 Hz-10 kHz filtering, 2.1-second sample-domain trim, 450 ms ending fade, peak normalization and MP3 encoding

mix.microphone: Immediate silence while pending, recording, or listening
mix.bellScheduling: Only idle; 40-75 seconds after the entry chime; without an entry chime the first ambient bell is 16-26 seconds after becoming idle
mix.visibility: Stop sources and suspend context while the page is hidden
mix.preferences: Local device mute and volume preferences; no effect on character voice
mix.entryBell: Once after clicking the cafe-entry button, when audio and session are ready; respects mute and is discarded if conversation, recording or page hiding happens first
